gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve a list of local incoming phone numbers associated with my Twilio account so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of local incoming phone numbers, including details such as the phone number, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a business owner, I want to create a new local incoming phone number for my Twilio account so that I can receive calls from customers.
gold.ideal: The API should accept parameters like area code and friendly name, and return the details of the newly created local incoming phone number, including its SID.
